allowlistHelp: Only these IPv4 addresses (CIDR) may connect. Defaults to loopback-only; widen it for LAN peers.
authNote: Use an API key as the credential — Authorization: Bearer '<key>' or x-api-key: '<key>'.
bindHelp: Loopback keeps the gateway to this machine. LAN lets other devices on your network reach it — you must widen the IP allowlist below for that to take effect.
concurrencyHelp: Cool down rate-limited accounts, disable dead ones, and cap concurrent load so a burst can't trip your upstream accounts' risk-control.
concurrencyWaitHelp: How long a request waits for a free concurrency slot before it is rejected with 429. 0 = reject immediately.
connectHelp: Point any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible client at the gateway by setting one of these environment variables.
connectTimeoutHelp: Bounds a hung upstream connection on every request, streaming included.
cooldownFallbackHelp: Park an account this long after a 429 with no Retry-After header, so failover stops re-picking it. 0 = honour upstream headers only.
cooldownHelp: How long a rate-limited or failing upstream account is skipped.
cooldownsHelp: Accounts cooling (rate-limited) or permanently disabled (quota / auth). Cleared automatically as cooldowns lift.
deleteKeyConfirm: Delete this key? Tools using it will stop working immediately.
description: Expose your configured providers as a local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint so external tools can borrow Cognia's routing and credentials.
desktopOnlyNotice: The gateway needs an HTTP listener and is available only in the desktop app.
disableKeywordsHelp: Error-body phrases that mark an account permanently dead (quota exhausted, org disabled) rather than merely cooled.
enabledHelp: Run the local HTTP server. Off by default; requires an API key.
exposedModelsHelp: Only these model or alias ids are listed and served. Empty = expose everything configured.
exposureHelp: Control which models this gateway advertises and serves.
fieldStripAllowHelp: Re-permit a stripped field for one provider, written provider:field.
fieldStripHelp: Request fields removed before the body reaches an upstream.
hideRawModelsHelp: Hide raw provider model ids from /v1/models — advertise routing aliases only. Direct provider:model calls still work.
keyExpiryHelp: Leave blank for a key that never expires.
keyModelsHelp: Comma-separated model or alias ids this key may call. Empty = every exposed model.
keyQuotaHelp: Cumulative input+output token budget for this key. Blank = unlimited. The gateway rejects the key once it is spent.
keyRateLimitHelp: Per-key request budget. Blank = only the global limit applies.
keysEmpty: No keys yet. Create one to authenticate external tools.
keysHelp: Issue one scoped key per external tool. Each can be limited to specific models, given an expiry and its own rate limit, and disabled or deleted independently.
lanWarning: LAN binding exposes the gateway to your local network. Keep the IP allowlist tight and every key scoped — only allow-listed IPs with a valid key get through.
listenerHelp: Where the gateway binds and who may reach it.
logHelp: Every inbound request, kept across restarts.
maxConcurrentPerKeyHelp: Simultaneous in-flight requests allowed per API key, shared across chat, embeddings and responses. 0 = unlimited. A streaming chat holds its slot until the stream ends.
maxConcurrentPerUpstreamKeyHelp: Simultaneous upstream calls allowed per pooled account, shared across all endpoints. 0 = unlimited. A streaming chat holds its slot until the stream ends.
maxRetriesHelp: Cap on candidates tried per request. 0 = walk the whole fallback chain.

nav.title: Gateway settings

newKeyReveal: Copy this key now — for your security it is shown only once.
overloadCooldownHelp: Park an account this long after a 529 overloaded response.
rateLimitHelp: Requests per minute across all keys.
reliabilityHelp: Timeouts, failover retries, and who may connect.
requestTimeoutHelp: Total cap for non-streaming requests. 0 disables it; streaming responses are never capped.
requiresKey: Create an API key before enabling the gateway.
restartRequired: The running listener still uses the previous values. Restart it to apply these changes.
retryStatusCodesHelp: Upstream HTTP statuses that fail over to the next provider instead of surfacing.
selfCheckBillingWarning: Each candidate receives a real request and is billed by that provider.
selfCheckHelp: Resolve a model through the real routing path and fire one minimal request per candidate.
selfCheckNeedsRunning: Start the gateway to run a self-check.
snapshotNone: No routing snapshot has been published yet.
streamIdleTimeoutHelp: Abandon a streaming response after this long with no bytes from the upstream. 0 waits forever, which leaks a concurrency slot if the upstream never closes.
strippedFieldsHelp: Client fields removed from every upstream request (billing / privacy / behaviour toggles). Dotted paths reach nested leaves.

tickets.activeHelp: Metadata only — ticket secrets are never stored or shown.
tickets.description: Session-scoped frozen routes issued to agent subprocesses (ADR-0090).
tickets.disabledDescription: Nothing mints tickets while this capability is off, so the list would stay empty. Turn it on above to start issuing them.
tickets.enableHelp: Stored locally for this install; off by default.
tickets.noneActive: No tickets have been issued yet.
tickets.routingWarning: This switch changes how agent runs are routed, not just what this page shows. Leave it off unless you are testing ADR-0090.
